page: Google Cloud Platform g2-standard-8 is a graphics-optimized virtual machine belonging to the g2 family. It features an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs, consisting of 4 physical cores and 2 threads per core, running at a base speed of 2.2 GHz. The processor is equipped with 38 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A core feature of this server is the inclusion of a single NVIDIA L4 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, which provides 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. There is no local NVMe storage bundled with this instance, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data reveals a clear division between CPU-bound tasks and GPU-accelerated workloads. Standard CPU performance is modest, with single-core and multi-core Geekbench and stress-ng scores falling into the weak to average categories. Memory bandwidth and static web serving throughput also register in the average tier. However, the integrated NVIDIA L4 GPU delivers top-tier performance for machine learning workloads, achieving exceptional token processing and text generation speeds in LLM inference benchmarks using 135M and 7B parameter models.

The g2-standard-8 offers a specialized hardware profile where the cost efficiency is highly optimized for GPU-centric tasks rather than general-purpose compute. The primary tradeoff is the lower baseline CPU performance and lack of local storage, meaning workloads requiring heavy sequential CPU processing or high-speed local disk I/O may face bottlenecks. This server is best suited for AI inference, small-to-medium LLM deployment, graphics rendering, and machine learning workloads that leverage the Ada Lovelace GPU architecture.
description: Google Cloud Platform g2-standard-8 is a graphics-optimized instance designed for GPU-accelerated workloads. It features an Intel Xeon x86_64 processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs, 32.0 GB of system memory, and a single NVIDIA L4 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage. While CPU-bound benchmarks, such as Geekbench and single-core compression, rank in the lower tiers, the server excels in machine learning tasks. It achieves top-tier performance in LLM inference benchmarks for both 135M and 7B models. This hardware profile makes the g2-standard-8 highly cost-efficient for GPU-dependent applications, though it presents a tradeoff in raw CPU performance. It is best suited for AI inference, machine learning, and graphics rendering workloads.
